title: Succubitus felix
html_source: Latin for “happily lying beneath/below” or “happily succumbing”. Related to the term succubus via late Middle English: from medieval Latin succubus ‘prostitute,’ from succubare, from sub- ‘under’ + cubare ‘to lie.’
